item.title: Boiling milk and worrying about the Iran war: A New Year dawns in Sri Lanka
item.summary: In Sri Lanka, Buddhists and Hindus marked their New Year on Tuesday while a war thousands of miles away is making itself felt.

item.title: A complex set of negotiations to end Israel's overlapping wars
item.summary: Israel has agreed to a ceasefire in Lebanon, part of a complex web of Mideast negotiations, from Iran to Gaza.

item.title: A jury declared Live Nation a monopoly. But ticket prices won't drop just yet
item.summary: D.C. and 33 states now have to argue in favor of specific remedies and fines, which could be paused if Live Nation appeals. Experts say the long-term impact on ticket prices isn't clear either.

item.title: House passes bill extending protections for Haitian migrants in the U.S.
item.summary: Ten Republicans voted alongside Democrats, in a rebuke to the Trump administration's immigration policies. Should it pass the Senate, the White House said President Trump would veto the measure.

item.title: The transformation of Terrace Martin
item.summary: After years spent as the go-to guy for a cross-pollinating L.A. music scene, the multi-hyphenate follows his spiritual mission inward for the sprawling series Love Is Louder Than The Algorithms.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Singer D4vd is arrested months after a teen's remains were found in his car
item.summary: The 21-year-old Houston-born singer, whose real name is David Burke, had been under a secret investigation by an LA County grand jury after a 14-year-old girl's decomposed body was found in his car.

item.title: Top five takeaways from Homeland Security budget hearings
item.summary: Lawmakers have been in a stalemate for over 60 days about funding the entire department, which includes agencies that oversee immigration enforcement, disaster relief, cybersecurity and the U.S. Coast Guard.

item.title: These musicians are providing the soundtrack for anti-ICE protests in LA
item.summary: Los Jornaleros Del Norte play protest songs whose lyrics reflect the hopes and struggles of undocumented workers as they evade immigration agents patrolling the streets.

item.title: Trump nominates former Coast Guard doctor as CDC chief
item.summary: The nomination comes after months of interim leadership at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

item.title: Minnesota has charged an ICE officer with assault for alleged actions during immigration surge
item.summary: Hennepin County officials say these are the first charges filed against a federal immigration agent related to the crackdown that brought thousands of federal officers to the state. The widespread operation led to the shooting deaths of two American citizens.
